integrity: A self-contained proof and standard-library exact rational checker accompany the theorem. All source comparisons are qualified by available material. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic local hyperbolic equilibrium stability only; the exact cost window holds for the specified nine-parameter family. The source already depicts qualitative three-way multistability, and the earlier two-mixed-root bound is acknowledged. No classification of global basins, cycles or stochastic persistence.
title: An exact sharp cost window for three attracting adherence regimes
